posts.cooked:
So, I decided to play a game using the heroes I mentioned here. The villain and environment were chosen randomly.

 

Episode 1

Advanced Infinitor versus The Argent Adept Kvothe Six-String, Mister Fixer, Expatriette, Absolute Zero, and Dark Watch NightMist in Omnitron-IV

Set-Up

Infinitor starts with Crushing Cage (on Dark Watch NightMist), Lambent Reaper, Twisted Miscreation, and Lambent Reaper.

The Argent Adept Kvothe Six-String (henceforth refered to as Kvothe) starts with Rhapsody of Vigor, Syncopated Onslaught, Instrumental Conjuration, and Silver Shadow.

Mister Fixer starts with Jack Handle, Toolbox, Overdrive, Alternating Tiger Claw.

Expatriette starts with Speed Loading, "Prejudice", RPG Launcher, and RPG Launcher.

Absolute Zero starts with Thermal Shockwave, Glacial Structure, Sub-Zero Atmosphere, and Onboard Modular Installation.

Dark Watch NightMist (henceforth refered to as NightMist) starts with Mist-Fueled Recovery (4), Call Forth (4), Astral Premonition (2), and Oblivion (2).

Round 1

Infinitor plays Crushing Cage on NightMist. Infinitor deals 4 damage to Expatriette (25). Infinitor plays Ocular Swarm. Lambent Reaper deals 2 and 2 damage to Kvothe (19). Twisted Miscreation deals 5 damage to Absolute Zero (24). Lambent Reaper deals 2 and 2 damage to Kvothe (15).

Kvothe plays Syncopated Onslaught. Kvothe uses Sympathy, revealing Onboard Module Installing and Speed Loading, Puts Onboard Modular Installation into play, discards Speed Loading. Absolute Zero draws Modular Realignment, searches for Isothermic Transducer, plays Onboard Modular Installation, draws Impale, searches for Isothermic Transducer, plays Impale on Infinitor. Kvothe draws Cedistic Dissonant.

Mister Fixer plays Jack Handle, then draws Charge.

Expatriette plays "Prejudice", uses Prejudice to deal 1 damage to Infinitor (64), and draws Submachine Gun.

Absolute Zero deals 1 damage to Infinitor (63), plays Isothermic Transducer, draws Onboard Modular Installation.

Each Crushing Cage deals 1 and 1 to NightMist (24). NightMist uses Attunement; putting Heedless Lash (3) ontop, followed by Mist Form (2), finally Mist-Fueled Recovery (3). NightMist draws Heedless Lash (3).

Omnitron-IV plays Conveyor Panels.

Round 2

Infinitor flips!! Infinitor plays Whispers of Oblivion, dealing 2 damage to Infinitor (61), Kvothe (13), Mister Fixer (26), Expatriette (23), Absolute Zero (22), NightMist (22), and all Manifestations (2). Infinitor plays Machinations of a Madman, revealing Insanity, discarding it and dealing 2 damage to Ocular Swarm (X) and the Ocular Swarm puts a Crushing Cage into play. Infinitor deals 2 damage to the newest Crushing Cage (2), all other Manifestations (X), Infinitor (59), Kvothe (11), Mister Fixer (24), Expatriette (21), Absolute Zero (20), and NightMist (20). Infinitor plays Insanity, playing Twisted Miscreation and Crazed Artifice. Crazed Artifice puts Ocular Swarm, Twisted Miscreation, Rescalescent Hellion, and Rescalescent Hellion into play. Infinitor deals 6 damage to Mister Fixer (18) and Expatriette (15), then destroys Crushing Cage, Ocular Swarm deals 2 damage to Kvothe (9), Mister Fixer (16), Expatriette (13), Absolute Zero (18), and NightMist (18). Twisted Miscreation does 6 damage to Absolute Zero (12). Twisted Miscreation deals 6 damage to NightMist (12). Rescalescent Hellion deals 4 damage to Mister Fixer (12) and Expatriette (9). Rescalescent Hellion deals 4 damage to Mister Fixer (8) and Absolute Zero (8).

Kvothe plays Silver Shadow, deals 1 damage to Ocular Swarm (3), then plays Instrumental Conjuration to put Xu's Bell into play and draw Arcane Cadence. Kvothe uses Xu's Bell to increase Mister Fixer and Absolute Zero's damage by 1 and deal 1 damage to Infinitor (58). Draws Eydisar's Horn.

Mister Fixer plays Charge, dealing 3 damage to Ocular Swarm (X), which then puts Lambent Reaper into play. Mister Fixer does 3 damage to Infinitor (55), both Rescalescent Hellion (1), and lambent Reaper (1), 1 damage to each Twisted Miscreation (3). Mister Fixer uses Strike, dealing 2 damage to Infinitor (53), both Rescalescent Hellion (X), and Lambent Reaper (X). 1 damage to each Twisted Miscreation (2). Draws Meditation.

Expatriette plays Speed Loading. Uses "Prejudice" to deal 2 damage to Infinitor (51). Draw Assault Rifle.

Absolute Zero deals 3 damage to Infinitor (48). Play Onboard Modular Installation, drawing Cold Snap and putting Null-Point Callibration into hand. Play Cold Snap. Absolute Zero uses Thermodynamics to deal 2 fire damage to self (6) and 3 damage to Infinitor (45). Draw Focused Appertures.

NightMist plays Heedless Lash (3), reveal Mistform (2). NightMist deals 2 damage to herself (10) and Infinitor (43), puts Mist Form (2) into play and draws Mist-Fueled Recovery (3) and Call Forth (1).

Omnitron-IV plays Overcharged Systems, Techno-Pursuer, and Resource Recycler. Techno-Pursuer deals 1 damage to a Twisted Miscreation (1).

Round 3

Infinitor plays Whispers of Oblivion, dealing 1 damage to the highest Twisted Miscreation (1) and lowest (X), also 2 damage to Infinitor (41), Kvothe (7), Mister Fixer (6), Expatriette (7), Absolute Zero (4), and Techno-Pursuerer (3). Twisted Miscreation restores to full HP. Infinitor plays Ocular Swarm. Infinitor deals 6 damage to Expatriette (1) and Destroys Ocular Swarm, reveal Crazed Artifice, causing Ocular Swarm to deal 2 damage to Kvothe (5), Mister Fixer (4), Expatriette (X), and Absolute Zero (2). Twisted Miscreation deals no damage to NightMist.

Kvothe plays Arcane Cadence, putting Inspiring Supertonic into hand, Sarabande of Destruction ontop of the deck, Scherzo of Frost and Flame on bottom, Telamon's Lyra in trash, and Inventive Preperation into play. Using Xu's Bell to increase Mister Fixer and Absolute Zero's damage by 1 and allowing Absolute Zero to play Focused Appertures. Draw Telmon's Lyra.

Mister Fixer plays Meditation, putting Driving Mantis into play.  Draw Bloody Knuckles.

Expatriette allows Kovthe to use a power. Kvothe uses Xu's Bell, increasing Absolute Zero's damage by 1 and allowing Absolute Zero to play Null-Point Callibration Unit.

Absolute Zero deals 5 damage to Infinitor (36), also 4 damage to Infinitor (32) and Techno-Pursuer (X), and 1 damage to Twisted Miscreation (3). Plays Sub-Zero Atmosphere. Use Thermodynamics to deal 4 cold damage to Absolute Zero (6). Draw Fueled Freeze.

NightMist draws 3.

Omnitron-IV plays Internal Defense Grid, Mechani-Accumulator, and Convueyor Panels. NightMist discards 7 cards to destroy Overcharged Systems. Resource Recycler puts Techno-Pursuerer into play. Internal Defense Grid deals 2 damage to Infinitor (30), Kvothe (3), Absolute Zero (4), and Mister Fixer but redirects it to Infinitor (28), also 1 damage to Twisted Miscreation (2). Mechani-Accumulator destroys Null-Point Callibration Unit and Convueyor Panels. Techno-Pursuerer deals 1 damage to Twisted Miscreation (1).

Round 4

Infinitor deals 6 damage to Mister Fixer (X) and destroys Twisted Miscreation. Infinitor Plays Rescalescent Hellion.

Kvothe plays Inspiring Supertonic, use Xu's Bell to increase Kvothe and Absolute Zero's damage by 1. Draw Ployphoric Flare.

Mister Fixer puts Kvothe's Telamon's Lyra into play. Expatriette allows Kvothe to use a power. Kvothe uses Telamon's Lyra, to use Inspiring Supertonic's Perform to use Xu's Bell, using Syncopated Onslaught to give Kvothe and Absolute Zero a damage increase. The Accompany on Inventive Preperation for Absolute Zero to play Modular Realignment, putting Null-Point Callibration Unit back into play. Absolute Zero deals 3 fire damage to himself (1), then 6 cold damage to himself (7), following by 4 cold to himself (11). Kvothe then uses the Accompany on Syncopated Onslaught to deal 3 damage to Infinitor (25).

Absolute Zero deals 5 damage to Infinitor (20), then 4 damage to Infinitor (16), Internal Defense Grid (6), Techno-Pursuerer (1), Mechani-Accumulator (1), and Rescalescent Hellion (X). Absolute Zero plays Fueled Freeze, destroying Sub-Zero Atmosphere, Cold Snap, and Impale, dealing 6 damage to Infinitor (10), Internal Defense Grid (X), Mechani-Accumulator (X), and Techno-Pursuer (X). Use THermodynamics to deal 3 Fire damage to Absolute Zero (8) and deal 6 damage to Infinitor (4). Draw Cold Snap.

NightMist destroys Mist Form. Plays Oblivion (2), revealing Mistbound (1) and Master of Magics (2). NightMist deals 1 damage to Infinitor (3), Kvothe (2), Absolute Zero (7), and NightMist (9). Then deals 2 damage to Infinitor (1). Attunenment, plutting Planar Banishment (1) ontop, followed by Mist of Time (4), and finally Mist of Time (3). Draw Planar Banishment (1).

Omnitron-IV plays Internal Defense Grid, Resource Recycler bring Techno-Pursuer from the trash, plays Partial Omnitron-Drone. Internal Defense Grid deals 2 damage to Infinitor (X).

Heroes win!!! Kvothe at 1 HP, Absolute Zero at 7 HP, and NightmIst at 9 HP. Mister Fixer and Expatriette incapacitated.

Another game, woo! Though not as detailed.

Episode 2

Advanced The Ennead versus The Argent Adept Kvothe Six-String, Mister Fixer, Expatriette, Absolute Zero, and Dark Watch NightMist in The Block

Heroes win!!! Kvothe at 11 HP,  Mister Fixer at 1 HP, Expatriette at 11 HP, Absolute Zero at 5 HP, and NightMist at 9 HP.

 

The game was fairly difficult at times, but thanks to Grease Gun and Mistbound, they had 4 turns where they did squat. Even with Nuit out, Mister Fixer used Riveting Crane to allow the heroes to keep on wailing on Set and Atum. Expatriette got a round 3 Tactical Shotgun, which was very nice. An early Cold Snap and Focused Appertures for Absolute Zero lead to him slowing widdling every non-hero target's HP. NightMist let off a couple of well timed Oblivions to weaking the villains significantly. All while Kvothe was giving the highest and lowest hero damage reduction and throwing out card plays, also using Vernal Sonata to rig the hero plays from Set. Kvothe even allowed Mister Fixer to get two Bloody Knuckles and an overdrive into play, with Dual Crowbars also around, it was a nasty sight. Also Char was his usual helpful self, dealing the killing blow to Set, allowing the heroes to focus on Atum and Nuit.

posts.cooked:
Episode 3

Chokepoint versus Parse, Setback, and Guise in Madame Mittermeier's Fantastical Festival of Conundrums and Curiosities.

Setup

Parse starts with Extrasensory Awareness, Reveal the Flaws, Snap Decision, and Impossible Shot

Setback starts with Cash Out, Exceeded Expectations, Surprised Fortune, and Plucky Break.

Guise starts with Retcon, Say Cheese, Best Card Ever!, and I Can Do That, Too!

Round 1

Chokepoint plays Material Upheaval, dealing 2 and 2 damage to Parse (22), Setback (27), and Guise (23). Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Setback (25).

Parse plays Snap Decision. Uses Pinpoint Shot to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (68). Draws Targeting Arrow.

Setback plays Surprising Fortune. Uses Risk to gain 1 Token (S1) and plays Uncharmed Life. Draws Silver Lining.

Guise plays Best Card Ever!, drawing Retcon and Gritty Reboot. Deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (66). Regains 1 HP for Guise (24). Woo!!! Plays I Can Do That, Too!, uses Risk to gain 1 Token (G1) and play Total Beefcake. Uses Tough Choices to draw Uh, Yeah, I'm That Guy!. Deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (65). Draws Uh, Yeah, I'm That Guy!

Madame Mittermeier's Fantastical Festival of Conundrums and Curiosisties plays World's Biggest Pool Table. World's Biggest Pool Table deals 2 damage to Setback (25) and Chokepoint (63).

Round 2

Chokepoint plays New Found Power, reveals Empowered Self Repair. Targeting Arrow, Plucky Break, and Retcon go face down in Chokepoint's play area. Empowered Self Repair is put into play, Regain 5 HP for Chokepont (68), Chokepoint deals 5 damage to Parse (17). Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Setback (23).

Parse plays Impossible Shot, dealing 3 damage to Chokepoint (65), and draws Gauge. Uses Pinpoint Shot to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (63). Draws Updated Intel.

Episode 4

Chokepoint versus Termi-Nation Absolute Zero, Termi-Nation Bunker, and Termination Unity in The Court of Blood

 

Setup

Absolute Zero starts with Onboard Module Installation, Hourfire, Cryo Chamber, and Coolant Blast

Bunker starts with External Combustion, Heavy Plating, Rechard Mode, and Grenade Launcher.

Unity starts with Turret Bot, Supply Crate, Robot Reclamation, and Swift Bot.

Round 1

Chokepoitn plays Newfound Power, revealing Empowered Self-Repair. Hoarfire, External Combustion, and Robot Reclamation go face down in Chokepoint's play area. Empowered Self-Repair goes into play, Chokepoint regains 5 HP for Chokepoint (70), and deals 6 damage to Absolute Zero (19). Chokepoint deals 3 damage to Unity (24).

Absolute Zero plays Onboard Module Installation, drawing Cold Snap and putting Isothermic Transducer into hand. Absolute Zero plays Coldsnap and uses Violent Shivers. Draws Fueled Freeze.

Bunker plays and uses Grenade Launcher, dealing 3 damage to Chokepoint (67). Draws Grenade Launcher.

Unity plays Supply Crate, drawing Supply Crate. Uses Reconfiguration and draws Bee Bot. Draws Brainstorm.

The Court of Blood plays Infecting an Heir.

Round 2

Chokepoint flips. Chokepoint plays Stripped Resources, destroying Infecting an Heir. Chokepoint destroys Bunker's face down External Combustion and deals 5 damage to Bunker (21).

Cold Snap has Absolute Zero deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (64). Absolute Zero plays and uses Coolant Blast to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (62). Draws Frost-Bound Drain.

Bunker plays Heavy Plating. Uses Grenade Launcher to deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (61). Draws Ammo Drop.

Unity destroys Supply Crate, drawing Modular Workbench and Hasty Augmentation. Unity plays and uses Modular Workbench, discarding Turret Bot and putting Swift Bot into play. Unity draws Flash Forge and Robot Reclamation.

The Court of Blood plays Hunter Fulepet.

Round 3

Chokepoint plays Kinetic Looter, destroying Heavy Plating and placing it Face-down in her play area. Chokepoint destroys the Face-down Robot Reclamation and deals 5 damage to Unity (19).

Cold Snap has Absolute Zero deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (60) and Hunter Fulepet (11). Absolute Zero plays Isothermic Transducer and uses Violent Shivers. Draws Modular Realignment.

Bunker plays Ammo Drop. Uses Grenade Launcher, dealing 2 damage to Chokepoint (58). Draws Omni-Cannon.

Unity plays Supply Crate, drawing Bee Bot. Unity plays Hasty Aumentation, uses Modular Workbench to discard Flash Forge and put Bee Bot into play. Unity uses Reconfiguration to destroy Bee Bot, Unity deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (55), destroys Kinetic Looter, moves Turret Bot into play, and draws Volatile Parts. Unity draws Flash Forge and Inspired Repair.

The Court of Blood  plays Drudge Ficko. Hunter Fulepet deals 2 and 2 damage to Drudge Ficko (1).

Round 4

Chokepoint plays Stripped Resources, destroyed all Environment cards and putting Hunter Fulepet and Drudge Ficko face-down in her play area. Chokepoint destroys the face-down Hoarfire and deals 6 damage to Bunker (15).

Cold Snap has Absolute Zero deal 4 damage to Chokepoint (51). Absolute Zero plays Frost-Bound Drain, dealing 6 damage to Chokepoint (45) and 7 damage to Absolute Zero (12), then deals 10 damage to Chokepoint (35). Absolute Zero uses Coolant Blast to deal 10 damage to Chokepoint (25). Draws Null-point Callibation Unit.

Bunker plays Omni-Cannon. Uses Grenade Launcher to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (23). Draws Heavy Plating.

Unity destroys Supply Crate and draws Platform Bot and Modular Workbench. Turret Bot deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (20). Unity plays Flash Forge, discards Modular Workbench, Robot Reclamation, and Volatile Parts to put two Raptor Bots and a Contruction Pylon into hand. Plays and Uses Construction Pylon to but two Raptor Bots into play. Unity draws Brainstorm and Platform Bot. Each Raptor Bot deals 5 damage to Chokepoint (10). 

The Court of Blood plays Blood Countess Bathory. Blood Countess Bathory deals 2 and 2 to Unity (15).

Round 5

Chokepoint plays Harvest the Mighty, dealing 5 damage to Unity (10) and moves Turret Bot face-down in Chokepoint's play area. Chokepoint destroys the face-down Heavy Plating and deals 5 damage to Bunker (10).

Cold Snap has Absolute Zero deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (8) and 1 damage to Blood Countess Bathory (14). Absolute Zero plays and uses Cryo Chamber, deals 4 damage to Absolute Zero (8) and 5 damage to Chokepoint (4). Draws Isothermic Transducer.

Bunker puts Heavy Plating, Grenade Launcher, and Recharge mode under Omni-Cannon. Bunker uses Omni-Cannon to deal 7 damage to Chokepoint (-3).

 

Hero Win: Absolute Zero at 8 HP, Bunker at 10 HP, and Unity at 10 HP.
